Terms of Service

Last updated: January 1, 2024

Welcome to Space Utilizers. By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully before engaging our services or using our website.

1. About Our Services

Space Utilizers provides interior design, space planning, architectural consultation, renovation management, and commercial fit-out services. All services are subject to a separate engagement agreement that will outline project-specific terms, scope, timeline, and fees.

2. Website Use

You may use our website for informational purposes and to contact us regarding our services. You agree not to:

  • Use the website for any unlawful purpose
  • Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems
  • Reproduce, distribute, or modify our content without written permission
  • Submit false, misleading, or spam content through our forms
  • Use automated tools to scrape or collect data from our website

3. Consultations

Initial consultations are offered on a complimentary basis and are subject to availability. A consultation does not constitute a binding agreement for design services. The scope, terms, and fees for any project will be documented in a separate written agreement.

4. Project Engagements

Proposals and Agreements

All design projects are governed by a written engagement agreement that includes:

  • Detailed scope of work and deliverables
  • Project timeline and milestones
  • Fee structure and payment schedule
  • Revision policies and change order procedures
  • Intellectual property terms

Fees and Payment

Payment terms are defined in each project's engagement agreement. Generally:

  • A deposit is required to commence work
  • Progress payments are tied to project milestones
  • Final payment is due upon project handover
  • Late payments may incur additional charges as specified in the agreement

5. Intellectual Property

Our Content

All content on this website — including text, images, graphics, design concepts, logos, and branding — is the property of Space Utilizers and protected by intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or use our content without prior written consent.

Design Work

Upon full payment, clients receive a license to use the design concepts created for their specific project. Original design files, concepts, and methodologies remain the intellectual property of Space Utilizers unless otherwise agreed in writing.

6. Limitation of Liability

Space Utilizers provides design guidance and recommendations based on professional expertise. We are not liable for:

  • Structural issues resulting from third-party construction work
  • Material defects covered under manufacturer warranties
  • Delays caused by client decisions, permit authorities, or force majeure
  • Indirect, consequential, or incidental damages

Our maximum liability for any claim related to our services shall not exceed the total fees paid for the specific project in question.

7. Client Responsibilities

To ensure successful project execution, clients agree to:

  • Provide accurate and complete information about their space and requirements
  • Grant timely access to project sites for surveys and installations
  • Provide decisions and approvals within agreed timelines
  • Make payments according to the agreed schedule
  • Inform us promptly of any changes that may affect the project

8. Cancellation and Refunds

Cancellation terms are specified in each project's engagement agreement. Generally:

  • Clients may cancel within 7 days of signing the agreement for a full refund of unused fees
  • After work has commenced, fees for completed phases are non-refundable
  • Materials ordered or custom items commissioned are non-refundable

9. Privacy

Your use of our website and services is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

10. Dispute Resolution

Any disputes arising from these terms or our services shall be resolved through good-faith negotiation. If negotiation fails, disputes shall be settled through mediation or arbitration in accordance with the laws of India, with proceedings held in Gurugram, Haryana.

11. Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to update these Terms of Service at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Continued use of our website or services constitutes acceptance of revised terms.
